assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas are provisional placeholders derived from the maintainer-registered provisional_boundaries.geojson; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics are package-consistent but must be recalculated when official polygons arrive; do not use for precise-area or statutory claims.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, conceptual building massing, road network, green/public spaces, and phasing are conceptual design layers generated from the provisional boundary; they do not represent existing parcels, real buildings, or statutory controls.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area and density are concept-level checks of spatial capacity only.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test/validation scenarios, personas, pilgrimage landmarks, event systems, and operation mechanisms are open co-creation concept suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: None are described as approved government arrangements, confirmed deployments, or statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Official boundary/key-area polygons, regulatory planning conditions (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks), road redlines, existing buildings/ownership, heritage controls, municipal capacity, and public-facility baselines are absent from the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: These gaps are recorded as risks and pending confirmation; they do not block content scoring but block official-redline-level conclusions.
